e.summary: Conformal Risk Control（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：保费充足性的期望损失保证
e.summary_en: Conformal Risk Control (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): expected-loss guarantees for premium sufficiency
e.summary_hk: Conformal Risk Control（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：保費充足性的期望損失保證
e.body: insurance-conformal-risk（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）实现 Conformal Risk Control：分布无关的期望损失保证——设置区间使期望风险（如保费充足性缺口）有界。对 RIAA：从「覆盖率保证」到「损失保证」的进阶——[[insurance-conformal]] 家族的控制版（Angelopoulos et al. 2023）；保费充足性场景（准备金/定价区间需要尾部充足）；与 [[insurance-conformal-claims]]、[[insurance-quantile]]（尾部）配套；适合风险管理方向的进阶工具。
e.body_en: insurance-conformal-risk (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) implements Conformal Risk Control: distribution-free expected-loss guarantees — setting intervals so that expected risk (e.g. premium sufficiency shortfall) is bounded. For RIAA: the step from 'coverage guarantees' to 'loss guarantees' — the control version of the [[insurance-conformal]] family (Angelopoulos et al. 2023); premium sufficiency scenarios (reserving/pricing intervals need tail sufficiency); pairs with [[insurance-conformal-claims]] and [[insurance-quantile]] (tails); an advanced tool for risk management.
e.body_hk: insurance-conformal-risk（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）實現 Conformal Risk Control：分佈無關的期望損失保證——設置區間使期望風險（如保費充足性缺口）有界。對 RIAA：從「覆蓋率保證」到「損失保證」的進階——[[insurance-conformal]] 家族的控制版（Angelopoulos et al. 2023）；保費充足性場景（準備金/定價區間需要尾部充足）；與 [[insurance-conformal-claims]]、[[insurance-quantile]]（尾部）配套；適合風險管理方向的進階工具。
